$comment: Generic lock-down policy template for a T3 Code v0.1.6 server run by a supervising connector. T3 Code has no managed-policy file of its own (see tailor/policy/README.md); install-policy.ps1 turns this template into machine environment variables, a read-only Claude settings file and an optional settings seed, and the connector launches 't3 serve' only with the 'serverEnvironment' below. No hostnames, paths, accounts or credentials belong in this file; machine-specific values are installer parameters.

claudeInstance.$comment: The installer writes 'settings' to <ClaudeConfigDir>\settings.json, read-only to non-admins. T3 reads it for a custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and downgrades Full access to Supervised when both modes are disabled.

environment.$comment: Set on the T3 provider instance (Settings > Providers > Claude > Environment), never machine-wide. Credential variables are entered there as sensitive values; see provider-config.md.

connectorToken.issueCommand: t3 auth session issue --scope orchestration:read --scope orchestration:operate --label connector --token-only

egress.$comment: Defaults for install-policy.ps1 -AllowedHosts. Override per machine.
